headline: Cards show up again on the new app. On some seats the card tool has to be switched on before it can be used; Command Room now switches it on itself instead of posting a plain list.

items.prompt_template: One fix. On the new app, and on seats whose chats already run in the cloud, your cards were arriving as plain text with no buttons: the card tool was there but switched off, and Command Room read that as missing. It now switches the tool on first and shows the card. Nothing changes on the older desktop app.
